name: Horrors in the Night
description: Always night, a much darker world where your light radius matters, permanent rain and snow, and (with the Horrors in the Night plugin) phantom monsters, lightning and thunder, and sandstorms in the Act 2 desert.
author: Latedozer

config.name: Night & darkness
config.description: Always-night lighting and a much darker world. Uncheck to keep vanilla lighting levels.

children.name: Always night
children.description: Every time of day uses the night lighting.

children.name: Darkness %
children.description: How much ambient light to remove on top of vanilla night (0 = vanilla night, 95 = near pitch black).

children.name: Moonlight cap
children.description: Upper limit for the main sky light. Vanilla Act 1 night is 4.5; lower is darker.

children.name: Monster visibility %
children.description: Monsters have their own fill light that shows them even in the dark. Lower this to hide them until they enter your light.

children.name: Gentler towns
children.description: Acts 2-5 towns lose at most 20% of their light. (The Rogue Encampment shares the Act 1 outdoor lighting and cannot be separated.)

config.name: Light radius
config.description: Shrinks the light around your character so your light radius matters.

children.name: Light radius reach %
children.description: Reach of the light around your character (100 = vanilla). Lower means you see less around you.

config.name: Weather
config.description: Fog, the rain / snow overlay and lightning. Uncheck to turn all of them off.

children.name: Thicker fog
children.description: Dark distance fog and low ground fog everywhere.

children.name: Fog thickness %
children.description: Adds dark distance fog and a low ground fog everywhere (0 = vanilla fog only).

children.name: Rain / snow overlay (not needed with the plugin)
children.description: A visual-only rain and snow overlay. The Horrors in the Night plugin now drives the game's real weather instead, so leave this off unless you run without the plugin.

children.name: Lightning (needs the Horrors in the Night plugin)
children.description: Adds the harmless lightning bolt the plugin drops near you during storms. It lights up the area around it for a moment.

children.name: Lightning light radius
children.description: How far each bolt lights up the dark (vanilla Thunder Storm bolt: 10). Raise it for a wider flash.

children.name: Lightning lights the whole sky
children.description: Turns the unused daytime lighting of stormy outdoor areas into the lit-by-lightning look that the plugin flashes for a split second. Only with Always night on. Turn this off if you remove the plugin, or daytime will look like a permanent flash.

children.name: Flash brightness
children.description: Strength of the sky light at the peak of a flash (vanilla daylight is 13.5).

children.name: Flash ambient %
children.description: Ambient light at the peak of a flash (vanilla daylight is 40).

config.name: Sandstorms in Act 2 (needs the Horrors in the Night plugin)
config.description: Turns the unused daytime lighting of the Act 2 desert into the height of a sandstorm, which the plugin fades in and out. Only with Always night on. Turn this off if you remove the plugin, or daytime in Act 2 will look like a permanent sandstorm.

children.name: Sandstorm thickness %
children.description: How far the dust closes in at the height of a storm.

children.name: Volumetric dust (experimental)
children.description: Also switches on the renderer's volumetric fog during a storm. The game itself never uses it, so it may do nothing, look wrong or cost frame rate.

config.name: Phantom monsters (needs the Horrors in the Night plugin)
config.description: Adds the false-monster rows that the d2rl-horror-night plugin spawns: unkillable, they drain life without killing, and vanish after a random time. Timing and strength are set in the plugin's horror-night.toml.

children.name: Townsfolk among the dead
children.description: Some undead phantoms carry the name of someone from that act's town. When one appears the plugin starts a haunting: your life orb reads 1 and nearby corpses get back up.
